# Getting help

1. Read the [FAQ](https://github.com/LASCAMPIA67/PlanetbaseTrainer#faq) in the README, which covers the most common
   problems: the menu doesn't open, a cheat is unavailable, the keypad doesn't respond…
2. Ask your question in [Discussions](https://github.com/LASCAMPIA67/PlanetbaseTrainer/discussions/categories/q-a).
3. Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/LASCAMPIA67/PlanetbaseTrainer/issues/new/choose) with the bug report
   form, and attach `BepInEx\LogOutput.log` from the game folder.

Security issues must be reported privately: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

English and French are both welcome.
